page_title: PAR 0-0 COM | Parma v Como 25/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Daniele Chiffi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Assane Diao (Como) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Parma.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Patrick Cutrone comes off the pitch to be replaced by Milan Djuric (Parma).
89' 30:70 – the ratio of ball possession.
88' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle after Nico Paz (Como) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
85' Ivan Smolcic (Como) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
83' Hernani (Parma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
81' The corner is swung in but Parma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

81' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the middle of the goal, but Jean Butez pulls off a great save to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Parma.
80' Diego Carlos (Como) is awarded a yellow card.
80' Diego Carlos (Como) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
76' Diego Carlos (Como) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Parma earn a free kick.
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) for Mateo Pellegrino.
75' Carlos Cuesta has decided to substitute Adrian Bernabe Garcia and he is replaced by Hernani (Parma).
74' Poor challenge! Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is penalised for tripping and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oliver Sorensen (Parma) is coming onto the pitch as Christian Ordonez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' Cesc Fabregas has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Martin Baturina (Como) replacing Lucas Da Cunha.
72' Anastasios Douvikas comes onto the pitch after Alvaro Morata (Como) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
71' Alvaro Morata (Como) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
69' Como can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

69' Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Como will have a corner.

67' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the right side of the goal, but Jean Butez pulls off a decent save to deny him.
64' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
63' Ivan Smolcic (Como) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
60' Alberto Moreno (Como) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
59' Como enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
55' Parma fail to score from a corner as Jean Butez (Como) leaps to collect the ball.
52' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Zion Suzuki gets down to his right to keep it out.
50' Como are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Mergim Vojvoda (Como) is replaced by Assane Diao.
46' Cesc Fabregas has made a change at the break. Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn has come on in place of Maxence Caqueret (Como).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Patrick Cutrone (Parma) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
41' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniele Chiffi stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Como win a free kick.
40' Diego Carlos (Como) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Daniele Chiffi blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
39' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
38' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

36' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies just over the bar. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
34' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) sends a cross into the box, but Jean Butez comes off his line to gather the ball.
29' Neat passing move from Como in order to create new attacking opportunities.
29' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Como have a free kick.
27' Alvaro Morata (Como) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
25' Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul after Ivan Smolcic (Como) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

23' Nico Paz (Como) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul. Parma win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
22' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
20' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

20' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Parma will have an opportunity.
19' Daniele Chiffi blows the whistle, Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is penalised for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Parma.
15' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
13' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
12' Como seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
9' Como work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
9' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Alvaro Morata (Como). Como force a corner. They send men into the box.
7' Maxence Caqueret (Como) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Zion Suzuki comes off the line to clear the ball away.
6' Alberto Moreno (Como) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
5' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
3' Alvaro Morata (Como) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
1' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) is flagged for offside.
1' The match has just started.
Parma will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniele Chiffi.
